archetypes.name: Boros Battalion
archetypes.plan: Build around Sunhome Guildmage: Curve out with multiple attackers, trigger battalion every combat, and use tricks to preserve the attacking force.

archetypes.name: Dimir Cipher
archetypes.plan: Build around Duskmantle Guildmage: Clear a path for evasive creatures, encode high-value spells on them, and protect the repeated combat trigger.

archetypes.name: Gruul Bloodrush
archetypes.plan: Build around Skarrg Guildmage: Attack every turn, represent bloodrush from hand, and choose between another creature or a combat-winning pump spell.

archetypes.name: Orzhov Extort
archetypes.plan: Build around Vizkopa Guildmage: Stabilize with defensive creatures, cast multiple cheap spells, and drain repeatedly with extort to win long games.

archetypes.name: Simic Evolve
archetypes.plan: Build around Zameck Guildmage: Order creatures from smallest to largest so evolve triggers repeatedly, then exploit the accumulated counters.
